hub.description: A community hub for sideloaded homebrew on Amazon's Vega OS Fire TV devices.

apps.name: VegaTube
apps.summary: Ad-free, sponsor-free YouTube for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks.
apps.description: Runs the official YouTube for TVs web app (youtube.com/tv) in a Vega WebView and injects the TizenTube userscript at document start, giving ad blocking, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, speed controls and themes on devices that cannot run the Android APK. Formerly TizenTube Vega — VegaTube is the FYAISA example app, with hub updates built in.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/vegatube with the Vega SDK.

notes: Contains a vendored copy of the TizenTube userscript (GPL-3.0); upstream credits live in the repos.
The FYAISA example app: pair with your PC for the in-app update menu, or use `fyaisa update app.vegatube.main`.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.
